evidence: XPS measurements were used to investigate the film composition. RBS and ERD measurements were used to determine the film composition (stoichiometry) and mass density. TEM images were used to analyze the film conformality and wet-etch resistance. Ellipsometry was used to measure the optical properties and film thickness. SIMS and XRR were not explicitly mentioned, but the text refers to XPS, RBS, ERD, TEM, Ellipsometry, AFM, Profilometry, Four-point probe, C-V measurement, SEM, XRD, and SAED as characterization techniques.
